name: Lacework
author: Erin Carter
description: A dark field of stitches — dots that morph into crosses as a radial wave passes through them, lit by four drifting glow blobs and tinted by angle into a faint rainbow.

params.label: Wave speed
params.effect: Speed the radial wave travels out from the centre, morphing dots into crosses as it passes; 0 freezes the pattern mid-morph.

params.label: Dot spacing
params.effect: Distance between dots in CSS px - a dense fine halftone lace at the minimum, an open sparse grid at the maximum.

params.label: Wavelength
params.effect: Spacing of the concentric morph rings; short packs many dot-to-cross bands across the frame, long sweeps one broad wave.

params.label: Lace brightness
params.effect: Brightness of the crisp dots/crosses themselves (the lace). Low keeps them subtle, high makes the halftone pop in vivid colour.

params.label: Backlight
params.effect: Strength of the four drifting glow blobs that flood soft colour behind the lace - the background fill. 0 leaves crisp dots on near-black (the original cleaner read); high washes the whole field in moving colour.

params.label: Dot size
params.effect: Radius of the resting dots. Small reads as a fine pin-prick halftone; large fattens them into bold beads before they morph to crosses.

params.label: Cross size
params.effect: Arm length and thickness of the crosses at full morph. Small keeps tidy plus-signs; large throws bold stitched X-bars across the cells.

params.label: Ripple depth
params.effect: How fully the passing wave morphs dots into crosses. Low barely flickers the shapes; high drives a strong visible ripple sweeping dot-to-cross across the frame.

params.label: Ripple count
params.effect: How many concentric morph rings span the field. Low is one broad slow wave; high packs many tight dot-to-cross bands rippling outward together.

params.label: Origin X
params.effect: Horizontal position of the point the ripples radiate from. 0 is centre; +/- drives the wave source off toward an edge for an asymmetric sweep.

params.label: Origin Y
params.effect: Vertical position of the ripple source. 0 is centre; +/- pushes it up or down so the rings arrive across the frame at an angle.

params.label: Morph bias
params.effect: Resting shape with no wave: negative holds everything as dots, 0 lets the wave do the work, positive biases the whole field toward crosses (a stitched-X lattice).

params.label: Crispness
params.effect: Edge hardness of the shapes. Low is soft glowing halftone dots; high snaps them to crisp high-contrast marks (the sharp halftone read).

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Spins the whole dot grid off the upright axis so the rows and ripple bands run diagonally.

params.label: Distortion
params.effect: Sine-warps the grid so the rows ripple and bow instead of running straight - a woven, hand-laid distortion. 0 is a perfect grid.

params.label: Ripple points
params.effect: How many points the ripples radiate from at once. 1 is a single concentric source; higher adds more emitters (shifted as a group by Origin X/Y) whose overlapping rings interfere into a woven, multi-centre lacework.
